Build 3D points, lines or polygons

Source: R/vector3d.R
as_vector3d.Rd

Builds a SpatVector3D from a table with one row per vertex, or from an sf object or terra::SpatVector with POINT, LINESTRING, POLYGON or MULTIPOLYGON geometries.

Usage

as_vector3d(
  x,
  type = c("points", "lines"),
  depth = "depth",
  time = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  lon = "lon",
  lat = "lat",
  depth_min = NULL,
  depth_max = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A data frame (or tibble, matrix, named list) with one row per vertex, or an sf object or terra::SpatVector. sf points take their depth and time from columns; sf lines take them from the Z and M coordinates; polygons take them from depth_min, depth_max and time.

type

"points" (default) or "lines", for tables and sf points. With "lines", the rows that share an id form one line, in row order. sf lines are always lines, and sf polygons always polygons.

depth

Column with the depth of each vertex, in positive metres downward. Not used for sf lines, whose depth is minus the Z coordinate (Z is height, as in other GIS tools), or for polygons.

time

Optional column with the time of each vertex: Date, POSIXct or text, read as in extract_to_point(). For sf lines, the M coordinate in seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC, if present. For polygons, one column (each polygon at a single time) or two (the start and end of each polygon's time interval). With dates, the interval covers whole UTC days, including the last: 1 to 15 February includes all of 15 February. The dates are stored as given, at midnight UTC, with time_resolution "daily". With hours, the start and end are exact times.

id

Column with feature IDs. Required for lines from a table; for points and polygons, each row is a feature and IDs default to the row numbers.

lon, lat

Longitude and latitude columns of a table.

depth_min, depth_max

Polygons only, and required for them: the top and bottom of each polygon, in positive metres downward. Each is a single number for all polygons (e.g. depth_min = 0, depth_max = 200) or the name of a column of x.

Value

A SpatVector3D. Columns other than the coordinates, depth, time and ID are kept with each vertex (points and lines) or polygon.

See also

geomtype()

Examples

obs <- data.frame(lon = c(150, 151), lat = c(-20, -21), depth = c(10, 35),
                  date = as.Date(c("2020-01-01", "2020-01-02")))
as_vector3d(obs, time = "date")
#> class      : SpatVector3D
#> geometry   : points 
#> features   : 2 
#> vertices   : 2 
#> depth (m)  : 10 to 35 
#> time       : 2020-01-01 to 2020-01-02 

dive <- data.frame(tag = "A", lon = c(150, 150.1, 150.2),
                   lat = -20, depth = c(0, 120, 15))
track <- as_vector3d(dive, type = "lines", id = "tag")
geomtype(track)
#> [1] "lines"

# A protected area from the surface to 200 m.
mpa <- sf::st_sf(
  name = "reef",
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(sf::st_polygon(list(rbind(
    c(150, -20), c(151, -20), c(151, -21), c(150, -21), c(150, -20)
  ))), crs = 4326)
)
as_vector3d(mpa, depth_min = 0, depth_max = 200)
#> class      : SpatVector3D
#> geometry   : polygons 
#> features   : 1 
#> depth (m)  : 0 to 200 
#> time       : none
